_comment: Principal portion of each recurring RENTAL mortgage payment, keyed by the exact ledger debit amount (the stable key even as servicers change). Principal rounded to nearest $10 (approximate is fine per owner). Used to compute the profitability/margin view, where principal is treated as equity build (not an expense). Only the principal is excluded in the margin view; interest + any escrowed tax/insurance remain real expenses. When a payment amount changes (e.g. escrow re-analysis), add the new amount here pointing at the same property/principal. Primary residence mortgage is intentionally excluded (rental scope only).
